decisive_spans.text: heterozygous variation c.482T>C (p. L161P) in KRT1

response.rationale: The genetic testing result directly supports D6 (Epidermolytic Hyperkeratosis) and is a definitive diagnostic criterion for this condition. While D4 (Bullous congenital ichthyosiform erythroderma) is also strongly supported by clinical and biopsy findings, the specific genetic mutation makes D6 the most likely diagnosis.
